changes.evidence: Marvel Rising: Initiation through Playing with Fire are all set in Earth-18878 (first appearance: Marvel Rising: Initiation). The chapter's own recaps mark Earth-18878 terminated only at Marvel Rising: Playing with Fire (Initiation's recap has no termination line), so the 49th world is not lost until then; the stage still precedes Helstrom (Fifty). Same pattern, not in this sample: in both Incursions rows (ch-incursions period and cx-incursions status) every stage from index 37 on sits on the first title of its world instead of the title whose recap marks it terminated (markers: Avengers Confidential, Avengers: Secret Wars (2017), Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United, LEGO Marvel Avengers: Mission Demolition, Baymax!, Fantastic Four (2015), Frost Fight!, Avengers: Black Panther's Quest, Legion, The Gifted, Marvel Super Hero Adventures, Marvel Rising: Playing with Fire, Helstrom, Hit-Monkey, Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur), the same fix part 5 already made for stages 3 to 33.

Earth-1226 is the shared reality of both M.O.D.O.K. and Hit-Monkey. The chapter's own recaps mark Earth-1226 terminated only at Hit-Monkey (M.O.D.O.K.'s recap has no termination line), so the count rises one title early; Hit-Monkey still precedes Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur (Fifty-two).
